problem: Historical HR work used email itself as an informal reminder/task system, creating continuity and deadline risk.

evidence.note: Counts are conservative subject-pattern counts from the complete 122-message no-recipient/self-reminder set. Categories overlap. Thirty reminders are shorthand, name-only, or case-specific and are intentionally not generalized without stronger context.

proposed_capability: Detect explicit and implicit commitments in HR mail.
Classify each commitment by workflow, owner, deadline, source system and required approval.
Link the commitment to authoritative current procedure before suggesting or performing an action.
Surface unresolved tasks until closed, while suppressing obsolete historical reminders.
Generate recurring checklists for validated cyclical work such as quarter-end, annual reporting or notices.
Keep employee-specific case details in restricted execution context rather than durable generalized knowledge.
safeguards: No automatic submission, employee-status change, benefit election, payroll change or external message without the configured approval policy.
Historical cadence is a candidate until current authority confirms it.
Do not create recurring reminders from one-off employee cases.
Deduplicate against existing Agent OS commitments and current HR workflows.
